Initial release of Video Editor with AI Online.

- Instantly edit and export 1080p videos by uploading clips and describing edits—no timeline or export settings required.

- Supports core workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements within a persistent session.
- Exports to multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.), with cloud GPU rendering for fast turnaround.
- Handles video uploads up to 500MB; includes helpful error messages and usage tips.
